'''Lefrani''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. It had a strong gravitational pull which prevented [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] from becoming a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Jestefad/Legends|Jestefad]].

Lefrani eclipsed the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Priate/Legends|Priate]] at the precise moment that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] began [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassinating]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|leaders]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' stated that Lefrani was the outermost planet of the Mustafar system;<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|II|159|Jestefad}}</ref> however, in [[2009]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' moved it to the fourth position, with [[Rietta]] taking its place as the outermost planet.<ref name="EA" />
